column1: # Real rows of the nf-core/rnasplice test-data run (contrast GBR_vs_YRI, treatment GBR, control YRI); source files: see README.md in this directory.
# expected_sign is the sign of the harmonised treatment-minus-control effect, derived from the rule in the last column.
# edgeR: the test data have 0 exon rows at FDR < 0.05 and 2 at FDR < 0.5; those 2 are used, and the third row (FDR 0.9999) is included only because it is the first row with a negative logFC.
# rMATS, DEXSeq exon, DEXSeq DTU: rows with FDR/padj < 0.05. SUPPA2 has no adjusted p-value: rows with p-val < 0.05.
# SUPPA2: the column name local_GBR-local_YRI_dPSI reads like GBR minus YRI, but the rule is flip: dPSI is control minus treatment (spec section 5), so the harmonised effect is -dPSI.
